agent_environment:
## Where you are

You are in the user's project, with the tools the session grants you. The swarm's documents are in the
`swarmer/` folder, at the project root: `PIPELINE.md` (the strategies and the phases), `PREAMBLE.md` (the extended
rules), `AGENTS.md` (the cards of all the roles), `JURY.md` (jury, new experts, plenary). If there is
`swarmer/local/`, its cards and rules apply in place of the generic ones. Write only in the folder that
the brief gives you; the rest of the project you only read. If a tool is missing or denied to you, do not work around it:
say so in the deliverable, and mark as «not verified» whatever you could not test.
environment_without_tools:
## Where you are

You have no tools: no files, no shell, no network. You work on the text of the brief, and your answer is the
deliverable. What would need testing you state together with the test it would take, and mark it «not verified».
agents_head:
# The agent swarm: the role cards

The roles are **professionals**, the general skills, and **sub-professionals**, their specialisations: a
sub-professional comes right after its professional, numbered «7.2». This file is generated from the single
database `swarmer/db/professionals.json`, in the chosen language: it is not edited by hand. A new role is added with
`bash swarmer/swarmer.sh approve <card>`; a project's own cards live in `swarmer/local/AGENTS.md` and
always take priority over the generic roles with the same id.

Outside the swarm is the **coordinator**: the main session that receives the request. Decisions are made by
the user, unless a jury has a written delegation.
description_tail: Swarm agent (core {core}); convened by the coordinator.
role_prompt:
You are the role «{name}» (card {n}) of the agent swarm: {short}

A coordinator convenes you with a brief: carry it out in your role and deliver as the brief says. You do not see the
coordinator's conversation or the work of the other roles, except what the brief gives you. Answer in English,
unless the brief asks for another language.
agent_note: generated from the card «{n}. {name}» of the swarm database: do not edit by hand, regenerate with bash swarmer/swarmer.sh regenerate
skill_note: generated from the swarm documents: do not edit by hand, regenerate with bash swarmer/swarmer.sh regenerate
document_note: generated by the swarm in the chosen language: edit it at its source, swarmer/docs/ or swarmer/db/
index_explains:
A role is convened by the name in the first column. The keywords help the choice: add to the profile's roles
those whose keywords appear in the request. A sub-professional is convened in place of its
professional when the request falls within its specialisation.

skill_description.auto: Convenes the agent swarm, leaving the coordinator to choose the strategy (single, fan-out, classic, jury, full, plenary, expert) and the roles. Use it only when the user asks for the swarm without saying which convening.
skill_description.single: Single swarm expert: one specialist, the best suited or the one named, with a complete brief (1 agent). For a clear question in one field or a small task. Use it only when the user asks for the swarm or one of its experts.
skill_description.fan-out: Swarm fan-out: N agents in parallel, on slices of a job or racing on the same brief under a selection rule declared in advance; a table of outcomes (2 to 16 agents). Use it only when the user asks for the fan-out or for parallel work with the swarm.
skill_description.classic: Classic swarm convening: contract, two blind lanes, triage, falsifiers' tournament, one team per hypothesis, tests and verdicts (6 to 15 agents). For deciding, designing, fixing, proving or measuring. Use it only when the user asks for the classic convening.
skill_description.jury: Swarm jury: a proposal already prepared, a jury that votes (consensus approves, majority revises for up to three rounds, minority rejects); as a rule the outcome is a recommendation to the user (7 to 11 agents). Use it only when the user asks for the jury.
skill_description.full: Full swarm convening: all the professionals in one blind round without a vote, the arbiter's consolidation, then the classic (costly). For strategic or open questions that touch many fields. Use it only when the user asks for the full convening.
skill_description.plenary: Swarm plenary: full convening, usual convening, critical pass, two arbiters, final vote with consensus (60 to 80 agents and more). Only for phase transitions and choices of enormously important impact, at the user's explicit request.
skill_description.expert: New swarm expert: convenes a skill that no role has, with a provisional card, and records the request; at the threshold it proposes creating the role. Use it only when the user asks for an expert the swarm does not have.
skill_description.light-jury: Light jury of the swarm: for small, low-influence decisions, or where a mistake shows up with a quick test: three jurors (the competent role, a critic, the guarantor), the test before the vote, a single round, then the ordinary jury if needed (5 agents). Use it only when the user asks for the light jury.

skill_title.auto: Swarm: the coordinator chooses the strategy

auto_preamble: **You choose the strategy of this convening**, with the rules below; then follow the paragraph of the chosen strategy.
full_preamble: **The strategy of this convening is the full one**, which after the consolidation continues like the classic.
plenary_preamble: **The strategy of this convening is the plenary.** Before launching agents, check that the user has confirmed it and state the cost. The complete rules are in `swarmer/JURY.md`, §5.
the_request:
## The request

$ARGUMENTS

(If there is no text above, the request is the user's last message. If it carries `language=<code>` (or `lingua=<code>`), answer in that language.)
the_request_generic:
## The request

The request is the user's message that called this skill (the text after the name of the skill, if there is one). If it begins with `profile=…`, `roles=…` or `language=<code>` (or `profilo=`, `ruoli=`, `lingua=`), those apply; with `language=<code>`, answer in that language.
launch_prompt: Use the skill {skill} ({path}) to convene the agent swarm for this request: {request}
cli_not_installed: the swarm is not in {root} yet. First: bash swarmer.sh install
cli_language_changed: Swarm language: {language}. Agents, skills and documents regenerated.
cli_language_unknown: language «{language}» not available. Available: {languages}. A new language is proposed with a pull request (CONTRIBUTING.md).
cli_aligned: {roles} roles and {profiles} profiles: catalog, agents, skills and documents in line with the sources
cli_not_aligned: Not in line with the sources: bash swarmer/swarmer.sh regenerate
cli_skipped: Not touched, because not generated by the swarm (overrides or project files): {n}
cli_missing_request: the request is missing: bash swarmer/swarmer.sh {strategy} "request"
cli_missing_claude: the claude command is missing: install Claude Code and log in
cli_approved: Role {ids} added to the database ({type}). Agents, skills and documents regenerated; swarmer.sh rebuilt: {script}. Proposal for the public repository: {path}
cli_proposal_written: Proposal written in {path}. To send it as a pull request: {command}
cli_updated: Updated {n} factory files; protected because modified in the project: {protected}
cli_left_modified: Left in place because modified in the project (compare them with the new version, then remove them by hand): {files}
cli_migrated: Installation migrated to swarmer {version}; going back to 4.0 is not supported. If CLAUDE.md has the 4.0 swarm paragraph, {command} rewrites it.
cli_removed: {n} generated files removed; {path} and the project's state folder remain
cli_reserved_warning: warning: the id «{ids}» is reserved (a strategy name, local or light): it is kept because it existed before 5.0, but a new entry with this id is refused
cli_cards_imported: {n} cards moved to the local overrides ({path}); the public database does not change
cli_translated: Translation of {id} into «{language}» registered in {path}; agents, skills and catalog regenerated.
cli_translated_english: English texts of {id} added to the database ({path}); agents, skills and catalog regenerated: the entry can now be proposed.
cli_translation_exists: {id} already has its texts in «{language}» in the database: to adapt them to this project write a local card
cli_translation_pending: Translations pending in «{language}» ({n}): {ids}. Before convening one of these roles the coordinator translates it and registers it with: {command}
cli_needs_english: {id}: the entry has no complete English text (texts.en), so it stays local: the public database accepts only entries in English. Translate it into English (name, short, keywords, body, same sections) and register it with: {command}
cli_local_until_english: {ids}: without the English texts the entry stays local; propose refuses it until it has them ({command}).
cli_targets_changed: Targets: {targets}. Agents, skills and instructions of the targets regenerated; the generated files of a removed target are gone.
cli_targets_detected: Detected in the project: {targets}. Available: {all}. Change them with: targets claude,codex,… (or auto), --add X, --remove X
cli_targets_empty: at least one target is needed (claude, codex, antigravity, gemini, agents)
cli_targets_remove_auto: --remove auto has no meaning: name the targets to remove
cli_target_inactive: {cli} reads the target {target}, which is not active in this project: {command}
cli_missing_cli: the {cli} command is missing: install it, or choose another tool with --cli ({clis})
jury_ambiguous_role: the role {role} has two different definitions ({a}, {b}): a juror must have only one
jury_regressive: (regressive revision discarded: yes in the round {yes}/{n})
requests_close: close ids, to merge or to tell apart with a reason: {ids}
pr_summary: Pull request to {upstream} with {n} entries: {ids}. Text: {path}
pr_not_sent: The commit will be signed as «{identity}», which becomes public. Not sent: repeat with --yes to confirm.
sh_not_installed: the swarm is not installed in {root} yet: bash swarmer.sh install
sh_incomplete: this file is incomplete: download it again
sh_unsafe_name: this file contains an unsafe file name ({path}): not installing it
sh_missing_python: python3 is missing or too old (3.8 or newer is needed)
sh_not_a_project: {root} does not look like a project: -C FOLDER install

missions.closure: The closure: at least one H# proven (Correctness proven or verified in its verdict), no open contradiction on an adopted conclusion, predictions resolved or declared unresolved with the test that would decide them, the four checks of the founding results. Also write {closure_file} with the line «Outcome: closed» or «Outcome: not closed», and at most three decisions for the user. «Outcome: not closed» is a recorded non-closure: name in it every branch without a verdict. If the sentinel did not work, write the line «Declared missing: sentinel: <reason>».
missions.owner_solution: You own {h}. Write the solution: steps, invariants, cost, «depends on», «invalidated if it changes». The predictions with their threshold go in PREDICTIONS.md, with the line «decides: yes» or «decides: no».
missions.proof: Write the proof or the check of {h}, after the owner's SOLUTION.md: what makes it correct, under which assumptions, and how it is checked.
missions.measurement_plan: The measurement plan of {h}: what is measured, with which threshold, before the tests. If no measurements are needed, say so and why.
missions.attack: The attack on {h}: the cases that should break it, with the predictions first.
missions.counterchecks: Run the counterchecks of {h}, cheapest first: first the falsifications, then correctness, then the dissimilar check. Predictions born now must be sealed by the coordinator before the tests.
missions.defects: The anomalies of the counterchecks of {h} and the hidden defects, each with its proven cause or «unexplained». If there are no anomalies, list the checks you made.
missions.verdict: The verdict of {h} by property (correctness, completeness, effectiveness, cost), with the line «Correctness: proven», «verified», «supported», «refuted» or «unresolved» (proven or verified only on the domain of use), and the dossier {dossier} completed field by field («missing» where something is missing). A field may continue on the indented lines below it. The dossier is bound at the gate G4, not at G3: complete it before G4.
missions.proof_contribution: Your contribution to the tests of {h}, on the measurement plan, after the counterchecks.
missions.cards: One card per idea: object, precise statement, type, risks, critical assumption and candidate counterexample, how it is checked. No merging: two ideas are the same only if statement and type coincide. Each card says which deliverable it comes from.
missions.triage: Assign the H# in the form H-001, with the class TEST, REFORMULATE, OPEN or REFUTED (only with evidence), and the top three in order. The coordinator seals the triage as soon as it arrives.
missions.tournament: Run the falsifier of every H# marked TEST or OPEN in the sealed triage, five minutes each at most, with the expected outcome recorded first. A refutation counts for the idea only if a check that does not share the prototype decides it; otherwise the H# goes back to REFORMULATE.
missions.selection: On the tournament's outcomes propose at most three H# plus a radical one, with ordinal priorities (expected information, cost, probability of a counterexample). End with the line «Countersign: arbitro».
missions.consolidation: Consolidate the contributions of the global round, first by core and then overall: facts F# with their state, contradictions K#, candidate ideas with their origin (role and file), open questions, roles to call next. No vote. The candidate ideas will enter f2 as input cards.
missions.lane_a: You are in lane A, the conservative one. Diagnosis of the problem and its constraints; two proposals, each with its statement, expected gain, constraints, who can test it and the cheapest falsifier (five minutes at most) with the expected outcome written first in PREDICTIONS.md.
missions.lane_b: You are in lane B, the divergent one. The creative: at most four ideas from distant fields, each with the translated mechanism and the test. The inverter: at most two inversions of the assumptions, each with the concrete alternative and the test. Every idea with its cheapest falsifier in PREDICTIONS.md.
missions.global_round: Global round, from your point of view: at most three observations or proposals, each with its evidence or falsifier. If your field is not involved, write «not relevant: …» in one line. Half a page at most.
missions.single: Carry out the request in your role, in full, and reread your work with your «questions it always asks» before delivering.
missions.fan_out_slice: You are an agent of a fan-out, with one slice of the work: yours is written below by the coordinator. Do only your slice, in full, and check the done criterion before delivering.
missions.race: You are one arm of a race: other agents have your same brief, and the coordinator will choose with the rule declared in the contract. Work alone, in full, and check the done criterion before delivering.
missions.owner_revision: You own {h}. After the counterchecks and the defects, write the revision: what changes in the solution and why, each change with the countercheck or the defect it answers; what does not change, with the reason. A prediction born now goes in PREDICTIONS.md and is sealed by the coordinator before its test.
missions.hidden_assumption_audit: The hidden-assumption audit (V2) of {h}: you took part neither in the construction nor in the reread. List the unstated necessary conditions of its founding results: versions, data representations, encodings, caches and state, call order, edges, empty domains, operational limits, differences between the theory and the behavior of the system. For each: where it is assumed, whether it holds, and the check that says so. A negative audit lists the conditions checked.
missions.sentinel: You are the sentinel: a role that was not convened, read only, twenty minutes. Put one assumption shared by the branches to the test with an external check, and recount from the files the figures and the identifiers of the dossiers. A K# of your own enters only with a file. Write nothing outside your folder.

convene.canary: (The first line of your deliverable must be this canary line.)
convene.criterion_tail: the contract's; if the mission below gives a stricter one, that one holds.
convene.question: Question
convene.outcome: Outcome at the top of the deliverable:
convene.outcome_tail: DONE, ISSUES or BLOCKED, with the evidence (rule 11 of the preamble).
convene.principles_text: The non-negotiable ones, if any; otherwise «none beyond the preamble».
convene.write_tail: No changes to the project, no git, no secrets.
convene.time_tail: minutes. Tests of class 1 at most (five minutes each) unless stated otherwise.
convene.output_tail: two pages at most; `status.md` in the same folder if you work more than ten minutes.
convene.forbidden_tail: the folders of the other agents of the convening, and what the contract excludes.
convene.signatures_readme: Every author of f1 writes `<id>.md` here: for every card born from their ideas, «faithful» or «lost: …».
convene.prepared_summary: Strategy {strategy}, profile {profile}, seed {seed}. No agent launched.
convene.prepared_next: Fill in {contract}, then: gate C f0 --notes '…'
convene.prepared_map: Lane map (yours only, do not give it to the agents): {path}
convene.roles_none: No keyword of the roles appears in the question: choose from the profile.
convene.snapshot: Snapshot of {n} files. Read after the last write: {read}
convene.gate_holds: Gate {phase}: the conditions hold (check only, nothing written)
convene.translation_pending: Translation pending in «{language}» (translation-pending) for: {roles}. Before launching them translate each card and register it: {command}
convene.gate_approved_not_closed: Gate {phase} approved as a recorded non-closure ({n} files bound): the convening is not closed
convene.branch_not_funded: {h} closed: not funded (the radical branch was never briefed)
convene.branch_funded: {h} funded: its dossier and its briefs are written
convene.radical_recorded: Radical {h} recorded, not funded: fund C {h} briefs it, close-branch C {h} --reason … closes it
convene.status_not_funded: {phase}: radical not funded (fund C {h}, or close-branch C {h})
convene.deciding_test_added: {h}: the test that would decide it is recorded in its early closure
